outcome: A salesperson prepares with a brief, keeps the customer's words, demos a prototype filled with their own kind of data by a five-step script, records reactions, and asks for sign-off only after the strict review passes
title: Forge covers building and sign-off records, but almost nothing the customer sees: no pre-meeting brief, no recap in their words, no realistic demo data, no demo script, no record of their reactions, and new projects are sent to a removed /office-hours step
